items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: she happen to be at the record date and when I went with our instruments in and we all piled in there

ctx.x: Made under extreme conditions but you got some songs under there that are just absolutely tremendous.

Well, I thought Helen Ward was just marvelous because she hadn't sang in a long time and that's the first time I really found out about Helen Ward. She happen to be at the record date and when I went with our instruments in and we all piled in there -- she was playing some beautiful
piano and singing; I never knew she played the piano. First time I knew that.
